_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `mimo acp` 0.1.15 (npm @mimo-ai/cli, linux-arm64) driven by the worktree's own AcpClient(acp_backend="mimo") over stdio, the model MiMo's own xiaomi provider `mimo-v2.6-flash/low`. The probe logged the turn's tool frames only (tool_call, tool_call_update, session/request_permission); text chunks and usage frames were not recorded, and `jsonrpc` is restored on each line. Reductions: session and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the probe's working directory written as ~/mimo-proj. One turn asked the model to run ONE foreground subagent through the fork's `actor` tool, the subagent to run a bash command. The `actor` call asks under its own `actor` permission (title `actor`, kind `other`, the request arriving before any update carries its arguments); the subagent shares the session, so its bash call asks on the same ACP session, its command on the preceding update, and both were approved.
